digest.component_or_area: LLM provider routing and model construction
propositions: Pydantic AI 1.107.2 constructs real OpenAIResponsesModel for openai-responses: prefix, but rebar routes to LLMConfigError before reaching it due to missing KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES entry and absent openai-responses key in _pydantic_ai_known_providers

Contract tests in tests/unit/test_openai_responses_contract.py parameterize identical assertions over openai-chat: and openai-responses: prefixes covering structured output, streaming, tool calls, 429 retry, and custom base_url routing against both wire protocols

Four production-construction constraints block openai-responses: usage in rebar: KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES lacks the qualifier, _pydantic_ai_known_providers derives from known_model_names() with no openai-responses entries, _PROFILE_RESOLVERS has no openai-responses key causing silent structured-output downgrade, and openai:→openai-chat: normalizers hard-code Chat

Custom base_url OpenAI-compatible endpoints (LMStudio, Ollama, vLLM, LiteLLM) via ProviderSession._build_openai are Chat-Completions-only by construction, keyed only to openai/openai-chat names and never receive openai-responses: strings

Third-party hosted providers (DeepSeek, Grok, xAI, Groq, Cerebras, Moonshot, Heroku) and gateway/openai construct only OpenAIChatModel under the 1.107.2 pin, with no Responses construction path exposed
Hosted OpenAI (openai:/openai-chat:) is Responses-ready at pydantic-ai layer; vendor-side /v1/responses support for third-party endpoints remains unknown evidence pending API documentation review
